preparation.disulfide_policy: OpenMM input parser topology bonds and Modeller cysteine variants

environment.protonation: Fixed OpenMM residue variants with explicit source-indexed overrides; pH-dependent defaults are not site-specific pKa estimates
environment.salt_convention: Added bulk salt excludes neutralizing counterions; integer ion counts approximate the requested concentration

forces_after.scope: Raw force-field forces; constraint forces are excluded. These values do not certify constrained-minimizer convergence

forces_before.scope: Raw force-field forces; constraint forces are excluded. These values do not certify constrained-minimizer convergence

preparation.minimization_assessment: Bounded OpenMM minimization; convergence is not certified by finite energy or the iteration limit

periodic_cell.scope: Cell geometry and cutoff compatibility; does not establish solute-image separation or finite-size convergence

preparation.protonation_policy: Remove supplied protein hydrogens; OpenMM Modeller pH-dependent variants and hydrogen placement

source_selection.scope: One supplied standard-protein chain; biological assembly selection remains researcher-specified

preparation.structure_metadata: Prepared topology supplies polymer sequence, entity and asym identities; coordinates and author IDs are OpenMM's export

result.scope: CPU/CUDA agreement at identical prepared coordinates using predeclared tolerances; native CUDA checkpoint restoration with zero propagated steps. These controls do not establish force-field accuracy, equilibrium sampling or bit-identical continuation.
